title: Chic Stops in the Suburbs of La Paz, Bolivia
abstract: The center of the city’s gentrification is now the Zona Sur, which sits 1,000 feet lower and is noticeably warmer than the far more visited colonial city center.

title: From Cocktails to Kimchi in Los Angeles’s Koreatown
abstract: New businesses have added flavor to the neighborhood’s energetic night life in recent years.

title: A Gleam of Renewal in Struggling Detroit
abstract: Corktown, once a desolate strip just west of downtown, is regarded by locals as a bright example of what rebuilding can do.

title: In Paris, the Bastille Neighborhood Recaptures Its Cool
abstract: Once cool then neglected, the Bastille area is now home to some of France’s most famous restaurateurs, chefs and designers.
